title: Model
description: A structure in the topic's framework, with the principles known to hold and to fail in it. Witnesses the consistency of the package satisfies ∪ {¬v : v ∈ violates}; every independence is derived from models.

name.description: Short construction or ordering name: family, rule, and distinguishing variant. Keep authorship, conjecture status, and lists of satisfied/violated principles in their own fields. Match the write-up title; keep the id stable.

description.description: The construction, and the verification of each listed principle. Required for proved models.

violates.description: Known failures, or the proposed failures for a conjectured model. May be empty for a consistency construction; an omitted axiom is not thereby negated.

model_check.description: For a conjectured extension of an existing proved model, identify that model and the particular new verdicts being proposed. These assertions must occur in this record's full satisfies/violates package. The conjecture is attached to those model checks and can only be resolved by evidence about the named model.

was_conjectured.description: Historical marker for a record that began as a conjecture. It does not change proof status or supply inference evidence.

checks.description: Paths of executable sanity checks (numerical, Lean, …).

source_names.description: Short display names corresponding to sources, in the same order.

references.description: References to papers.yaml; roles distinguish definition origins and background from direct proofs.

changes.description: Dated revision log. Append an entry whenever a record gains content after its certificate date (new verified properties, an added proof, a corrected statement). The Changes tab lists each entry under its own date; certificate.date stays the record's original date.

by.description: Who supplied the revision's content (author or agent, with date if useful).

summary.description: What changed and why, in one or two sentences.

satisfies.description: Principles newly verified to hold in this revision; must also appear in the record's satisfies.

violates.description: Principles newly verified to fail in this revision; must also appear in the record's violates.

tier.description: Human ranking of an unresolved question by importance and difficulty, shown on its lynchpin star. A conjecture with notes is bronze on its own; silver and gold are given by hand.
